parameterGate.hits: Absent uses native default 2. Explicit integer hits >=0 accepted without an upper bound; native source clamps values above cardamoms (6 at C0, up to 10 with C1 HP bonus). Negative hits rejected because mine-hits loop emits zero while c.cardamoms -= hits raises the later expiry count.
parameterGate.mine_delay: Absent uses native default 180 frames; explicit 180 accepted. Any other value remains outside this audited graph because it can reorder mine-hit, snapshot and expiry callbacks.
parameterGate.other: Native method ignores other integer map keys; shared invocation validation already requires all provided parameter values to be integers.
parameterGate.overlap: Reject another same-character Q whose damage-task/dispatch lifetime overlaps this invocation, because mineSnap, minePattern and cardamoms are fields shared across casts.
